evidence_scope: Offline calculations from an existing native 200 Hz PhysX recording.
No newly executed simulation, inference, training, native readback or controller tuning.

baseline.sampling_note: Four held physical action rows per policy decision. action_was_applied is true for all four held substeps; it must not be counted as four independent decisions.

contact_stability_analyzer.scope: Definitions of force-bearing contact and censored contact runs. Additional native-phase/torque-edge statistics are direct NumPy calculations described in this audit.

upstream_configuration_reference.scope: Local upstream configuration source used to trace inherited rewards; not a native runtime readback.

recorded_core_diagnostics.bearing_contact_definition: Each wheel has at least one actual ground point with normal force >5 N. In this recording, both-wheel count and both-wheel aggregate Fz>5 N masks are identical.
recorded_core_diagnostics.high_frequency_definition: >10 Hz; one-sided Parseval normalization, linear detrend, Hann window, channel-mean world-angular-XY power.
recorded_core_diagnostics.near_80nm_definition: abs(applied_torque)>=79.2 Nm; this is NOT the true saturation fraction of the speed-dependent motor envelope.
recorded_core_diagnostics.reference_beta_target: The intended nonzero reference; not a zero-slip objective.
recorded_core_diagnostics.phase_comparison_note: Native clock phases within the inclusive core window, including its two phase-zero boundaries. This is descriptive sampling evidence, not a causal attribution or an exact decomposition of logged PPO reward.

torque_edge_diagnostics.calculation: Adjacent native rows both inside the core window; a new-decision edge has new-row index modulo4 equal1, other edges are held-action edges. RMS pools all6legs; sign flips use tau_old*tau_new<0 without an added magnitude threshold.
torque_edge_diagnostics.interpretation: Action changes coincide with larger torque discontinuities, while nonzero torque changes remain inside unchanged-action windows. Both explicit feedback/contact dynamics and command changes are present; no sole cause is identified.

original_height_smoothness.sampling: One bounded control-interval mean acceleration cost; not all-substep acceleration, jerk, force-rate or torque-rate.

indirect_posture_preferences_retained: Tilt regularization and orientation safety predicate
Reference-height observations remain available to the actor

original_grounded_reward.sampling: Last native substep, evaluated at the 50 Hz reward clock.

height_and_existing_reward_findings.evaluation_caveat: The frozen full-horizon evaluator retains the historical pose-predicate functions but wraps their returned flags with false. The report logs zero triggers here. Evaluation reward computation does not optimize or retrain the frozen actor.
height_and_existing_reward_findings.physics_ground_constraint_note: Rigid ground collision and remaining orientation/XY/leg-geometry preferences can influence height indirectly; absence of an absolute Z reward is not absence of physical vertical dynamics.

introduced_dense_ground_support_method.status_in_this_audit: Method definition only; no success outcome is inferred from preparation or the training launch.
fixes_in_the_objective: Every actual physical substep contributes rather than only the final substep.
The reward responds smoothly to low wheel normal load before a binary 5 N transition.
Each wheel contributes separately, avoiding one highly loaded wheel directly substituting for an unloaded partner.
Only the actual ground-filtered normal-force channels contribute; robot self-contact is not a source of grounded reward.
does_not_fix_or_guarantee: No hard continuous-contact condition or minimum normal-force constraint.
The 0.20 mg scale is not a required load and does not impose a 50:50 load split.
Mean aggregation still permits brief unloading within a control interval.
No new torque-rate, contact-force-rate, wheel-normal-velocity or all-substep vertical-acceleration penalty.
No increase of the 50 Hz policy control rate.
No new contact-force observation for the actor.
No change to rigid wheel shape, tire compliance, solver, offsets, PD gains or motor envelope.
No absolute height target, zero-yaw target or zero-sideslip target.

configured_physics_not_new_native_readba.offset_status: Not explicitly authored in the inspected current source/asset. Effective inherited native values are unknown in this audit.

interpretation_and_possible_later_work.observed: Large physical torque/body oscillations and frequent loss of measured bearing load coexist with good nominal XY/speed/beta tracking.
interpretation_and_possible_later_work.not_observed_in_this_recording: No nonwheel ground impact; wheel net and ground-normal force channels agree to approximately 2.44e-4 N. This does not exclude nonwheel robot self-collisions, which are not fully recorded.
interpretation_and_possible_later_work.no_universal_25hz_claim: The audited -0.5 recording is dominated near14 Hz. Older policies'25 Hz signatures must not be assigned to every replay.
interpretation_and_possible_later_work.precondition_for_any_future_contact_nume: Obtain separately labeled authored/native readback of solver counts and contact/rest offsets, using installed_contact_api_audit.json. Do not add a physics step or change an active locked run to obtain it.
interpretation_and_possible_later_work.possible_single_factor_not_executed: If chatter persists after the dense-reward policy is evaluated, a separately authorized fixed-actor solver-velocity-iteration change could probe numerical sensitivity. A timestep change would also change the explicit motor feedback sampling and must be labeled accordingly.
interpretation_and_possible_later_work.lower_gain_interpretation: An unsuccessful zero-shot Kp250 or Kd5 deployment does not disprove a newly trained policy using lower gains.
limitations: One deterministic policy/reference/friction recording; no causal identification or statistical robustness.
A missing >5N bearing point is not a geometric separation/flight certificate.
No new native solver/offset readback was performed.
No controller, reward, asset, physics setting or existing result was modified by this audit.
